name: Tomb of Thieu Tri
kicker: The only tomb that faces northwest
summary: Visit the only Nguyễn tomb that faces northwest, in Cư Chánh village, Thủy Bằng, about 8 km from the citadel. Rice fields stand in for an outer wall, and the Perfume River runs in front. An adult ticket is 50,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 is free. It is not on the four-site ticket.
getThere: About 8 km from the citadel. Minutes are check on arrival.

notice.body: Thieu Tri is a 50,000 VND adult ticket. The four-site ticket does not include it. A child from 7 to 12 is free.

body: Xương Lăng is the only Nguyễn tomb turned northwest. The centre places it in làng Cư Chánh, xã Thủy Bằng, huyện Hương Thủy, about 8 km from the citadel. Chằm mountain is the screen about 8 km in front. The Perfume River is the open path in front of the tomb. There is no outer wall. The rice fields and orchards are the wall.

Thiệu Trị did not build a tomb in his lifetime. After he died, the main works were finished in about three months, and Tự Đức came to check the site on 14 June 1848. The tomb and the temple sit side by side, not on one axis. Đức Hinh pavilion stands on a low hill, and the temple area is about 100 metres to its left.

An adult ticket is 50,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 is free. Under 7 is free. Hue residents and the other groups named in Resolution 55 pay half. How long the two zones take, and the ride from the south bank, is check on arrival.

gettingThere: From the south bank, the tomb is about 8 km from the citadel, in Cư Chánh, Thủy Bằng, Hương Thủy. Go by bicycle or taxi. The minutes are check on arrival.
